variants_built: pch_day1_alt_inland_bypass.gpx (326.2 km - Devil's Slide Trail gate insurance)
open_actions: BOOK Limekiln on ReserveCalifornia 800-444-7275 - no walk-up sites exist
CALL San Mateo County Parks re Devil's Slide Trail access before 08:00; otherwise ride the inland bypass
CHECK Caltrans QuickMap on the morning - Rocky Creek Bridge one-way control runs 24/7 through 31 Aug 2026, up to 15 min delay
CALL (805) 968-1033 for the Refugio/Gaviota per-person hike-bike rate (not published; the $10/person figure is unverified)
BOOK the bicycle on the Coast Starlight out of LA Union Station - separate reservation, limited space
